papers.title: Selective laser melting of pure Zn with high density for biodegradable implant manufacturing
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Politecnico di Milano, Via La Masa 1, 20156 Milan, Italy

corresponding_authors.name: Ali Gökhan Demir
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Politecnico di Milano, Via La Masa 1, 20156 Milan, Italy

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及通过SLM制造纯锌可降解植入物，但未研究多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on achieving high density in pure Zn for biodegradable implants, but does not address porous structures for stiffness matching, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发可降解植入物的制造方法，避免二次手术。
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化工艺制备高密度纯锌样品。
summary_zh.result: 实现了近全密度纯锌植入物的制造，具有良好机械性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过密度测量和力学测试验证样品质量。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a manufacturing process for biodegradable implants to avoid secondary removal surgery.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to fabricate pure zinc samples with high density.
summary_en.result: Near-full-density pure zinc implants were successfully produced with adequate mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Density measurements and mechanical testing were conducted to verify sample quality.

papers.title: Total Hip Arthroplasty on Treatment of Traumatic Arthritis Caused by Internal FixationFailures of Intertrochanteric Fractures

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文仅讨论全髋关节置换术治疗创伤性关节炎的临床效果，未涉及任何力学建模或生物力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical retrospective study with no biomechanical modeling, no stress/strain quantification, no micromotion analysis, and no patient-specific FE boundary conditions.

summary_zh.motivation: 探讨全髋关节置换术治疗内固定失败后创伤性关节炎的疗效。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析接受全髋关节置换术的患者临床数据。
summary_zh.result: 全髋关节置换术可有效改善关节功能，但未提供力学数据。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the clinical outcomes of total hip arthroplasty for traumatic arthritis following internal fixation failure.
summary_en.method: A retrospective analysis of patients undergoing THA was conducted.
summary_en.result: THA improved joint function, but no biomechanical data were reported.
